chapter: Later career, civil service and jazz seminars
title: Playing around New York as leader and sideman since 1946
summary: After 1946 Caldwell played with his own groups and as a sideman, often at Bing's place.

story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Now, wait -- you've got to -- I mean what have you been doing in recent years. We've got to cover that too.
Oh, soon as I came back from -- well, --
I mean you -- we were talking about you going into masonry in '46. Now, you've -- from that time on, I take it, you were playing around New York.
Were you playing with your own groups as a side man?
No, I played both -- then I've worked

with guys who get stuck. They call me. A lot of guys I (unintelligible) think I couldn't play with them because I was being with groups of my own. I said, no, you're stuck. I'll be with you. (Go, or why) (unintelligible) -- I was playing a side man.
You played in Bing's place often, did you?
